grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings (threshold for C is max 2 P1s). 4 CVSS-9.8 dependency CVEs + 1 tool gap giving false-green traceability gate. 12 P2 findings. Spec coverage 72% (active requirements).
skipped_reason: Services offline — backend and frontend not running during audit. Static mode only.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to tiered-merge-pipeline spec — reports false PASSED
p1_findings.impact: 10 unimplemented functional requirements (FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010) are invisible to the CI gate. python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py returns PASSED while spec coverage for tiered-merge-pipeline is 0%. Gate gives false confidence.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add multi-spec support to enforcer (scan all Specifications/*.md for FR patterns) OR mark tiered-merge-pipeline.md as status: deferred. Either way the gate must not silently skip active specs.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars.js CVSS 9.8 — JavaScript injection via AST type confusion
p1_findings.impact: Attacker bypasses sandbox via crafted @partial-block directives, achieving arbitrary code execution in the backend process.
p1_findings.recommendation: Upgrade: cd Source/Backend && npm install handlebars@latest && npm test

p1_findings.title: Vitest CVSS 9.8 — arbitrary file read/execution when UI server running
p1_findings.impact: Attacker can read and execute arbitrary files on the dev/CI machine running the Vitest UI server. Affects source code and .env secret exposure.
p1_findings.recommendation: Upgrade: cd Source/Frontend && npm install vitest@latest && npm test

p1_findings.title: Protobufjs CVSS 9.8 — arbitrary code execution on orchestrator
p1_findings.impact: Malformed .proto files or crafted protobuf messages can inject code into generated message classes. Orchestrator is infrastructure — compromise affects all agents.
p1_findings.recommendation: Upgrade: cd platform/orchestrator && npm install protobufjs@latest @grpc/grpc-js@latest && npm test. NOTE: platform/ is solo-session only — pipeline agents must not touch this directory.

p1_findings.title: Portal Backend — 54 accumulated CVEs (2 critical, 11 high); no npm audit enforcement
p1_findings.impact: Debug portal is a pivot point for attackers. 54 known vulnerabilities indicate long gap since last dependency maintenance and no CI enforcement. Portal is not isolated from main application.
p1_findings.recommendation: Run: cd portal/Backend && npm audit fix --force && npm test. Add npm audit to CI/CD pipeline to fail on critical/high CVEs.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010 — zero implementation
p2_findings.recommendation: Either create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md to formally track implementation, or add Status: Deferred — Phase 2 to the spec header.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer bypassed
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract Source/Backend/src/services/workItem.ts. Route handlers: validate input → call service → return response.

p2_findings.title: E2E test harness is a stub — zero test files, test command fails
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement smoke-test E2E specs OR remove Source/E2E/ from workspace to stop gate failures.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion — 6 DoS CVEs (exponential expansion, stack exhaustion, OOM)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix across Source/Backend and Source/Frontend

p2_findings.title: browserslist — unbounded memory growth + crash via malformed stats file
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix to upgrade browserslist >=4.28.7

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection — HTTP header smuggling (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix to upgrade form-data >=4.0.6
p2_findings.escalate_reason: injection — CRLF header injection / HTTP smuggling

p2_findings.title: js-yaml — quadratic-complexity DoS via merge-key chains (4 CVEs)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix to upgrade js-yaml >=3.15.2

p2_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js — malformed requests crash orchestrator; cert validation bypass
p2_findings.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm install @grpc/grpc-js@latest. Solo-session only.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — catastrophic backtracking on malformed URLs
PostCSS — arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL path traversal
nanoid — integer overflow and infinite loops (3 CVEs)
ws — memory exhaustion DoS via tiny WebSocket fragments

p3_findings.title: Silent .catch(() => ({})) swallows JSON parse error without documentation
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining the intentional suppression.

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Remove root-level test files; keep tests/pages/ variants as canonical.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions lack rationale comments
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline rationale comments explaining why deps are intentionally omitted.

p3_findings.title: Multiple moderate DoS and path-traversal CVEs (aggregated)
p3_findings.recommendation: npm audit fix across all projects to clear moderate CVEs.

p3_findings.title: React 18.3.1 is one major version behind (latest: 19.3.0)
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan React 19 upgrade for next minor release cycle.

p3_findings.title: react-router-dom 6.30.6 one major behind — contains open redirect CVE
p3_findings.recommendation: Prioritize upgrade to react-router-dom@7 to resolve open redirect.

p3_findings.title: Build tools (vite, vitest, postcss) have known CVEs — dev machine risk
p3_findings.recommendation: Update all build tools; run builds in containers where possible.

p4_findings.title: No obviously abandoned packages found; monitor quarterly
p4_findings.recommendation: Run npm audit regularly; CLI flags deprecated packages.

escalations.reason: injection — handlebars CVSS 9.8 JavaScript injection/RCE in Source/Backend
injection — protobufjs CVSS 9.8 code injection on orchestrator infrastructure
injection — form-data CRLF injection enabling HTTP header smuggling

cross_references.root_cause: No npm audit enforcement in CI/CD pipeline
cross_references.single_fix: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to CI pipeline with fail-on-critical gate. This prevents future accumulation of all 13 dependency findings.
cross_references.impact: Resolves 13 findings (all DEP-005 through DEP-013 prevented from recurrence)

cross_references.root_cause: Traceability enforcer scans only most-recently-modified requirements.md in Plans/
cross_references.single_fix: Extend enforcer to scan all Specifications/*.md for FR patterns. This fixes the false-green gate (QO-001) and makes QO-002 visible to the enforcement gate.
cross_references.impact: Resolves 2 findings; enforcer becomes reliable across all spec families

cross_references.single_fix: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItem.ts wrapping all store CRUD operations.
cross_references.impact: Resolves 1 finding; unlocks testability and future DB migration
